message:
chore(perimeter): the last two umbrella strays are disposed of

The end-state reconciliation removed everything outside main that was
redundant. HANDOFF.md was consumed (every task it handed off had landed),
and original_research.txt left with the rest of the finished workbench as
its entry asked: filed with the intelligence-plane audit record. Both now
live only in the off-tree reconciliation archive.

test_perimeter's self-cleaning rule requires a disposed-of path to leave
pending_disposition, so the list is empty again. workbench/ and outputs/
remain declared, as empty scratch directories, so the perimeter check
still applies.
